details:
When posting an announcement using groups, have the option to add “tags”, tags such as “Event/Meetup”, “Group Announcement” or “Avatar Release.” Sometimes users may join a group and get bombarded with announcements, maybe they joined for car meetups but they get so many announcements from other things that they just disable notifications from that group, causing them to miss out on the announcements they really want. 

Tags can fix this issue and also add organization to your the new groups. If you could disable notifications from specific tags that would let players have more control over the content they get notified about, rather then getting 6 notifications about avatar updates or world releases. They get notified about the weekly meetup they joined for!

I have a lot of hope for the group feature and I would love to see more developments towards it!
title: Announcement Tags for Groups
